# Lich (54 mm base) by YKS Miniatures

Sculpt by **YKS Miniatures**: <https://www.myminifactory.com/users/YKSMiniatures>.
Included as a test model with the permission of the repository owner, on the
condition that the creator is credited. All rights to the sculpt stay with its creator;
it is not covered by this repository's GPL licence.

- `lich-base-54mm.stl`: 25,440 triangles, upright, closed.
- `lich-base-54mm_reduced.stl`: 99,586 triangles, tilted and floating 4 mm above the
  bed, as the owner prepares it for supports.
